# OSV IDs accepted by scripts/govulncheck.sh.
#
# One finding per line: the OSV ID, whitespace, then the reason it is accepted.
# Comments and blank lines are ignored. Only add an entry when the dependency
# cannot be upgraded yet or the affected code path cannot be reached by this
# provider; a missing fix is a temporary state, not a permanent exemption.
#
# Example:
#   GO-2026-1234  no fixed release; the affected xDS path is never configured
#
# The gate prints accepted entries on every run and warns when an entry no
# longer matches, so entries are revisited instead of forgotten.
